Essential Cookies Essential Cookies Always active Essential cookies are critical for ensuring the proper functioning, compliance, and user experience of the website. The countrycode cookie (first-party) enables region-specific content delivery by identifying the user’s location. Third-party cookies such as VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA and li_gc are used to manage and store user consent preferences, ensuring that privacy choices are respected across sessions and that regulatory requirements are met. Collectively, these cookies support core functionalities like localization and consent management, without which the website may not operate as intended. Preferences Preferences The technical storage or access is necessary for the legitimate purpose of storing preferences that are not requested by the subscriber or user. Performance Cookies Performance Cookies Performance cookies are used to collect aggregated data about how visitors interact with the website, enabling continuous improvement of functionality and user experience. Cookies such as _gid, _ga, and _ga_* (first-party) are set by Google Analytics to track page views, distinguish unique users, and maintain session state for accurate analytics reporting. Additionally, the _cn cookie gathers information on visit frequency and overall site usage. Together, these cookies provide insights into user behavior and site performance, helping optimize content, navigation, and overall efficiency without directly identifying individual users. The technical storage or access that is used exclusively for anonymous statistical purposes.
